title: Midwest G7-M reservations launch playbook and ops runbook
text:
Midwest G7-M reservations launch playbook and ops runbook

description:
Launch coordination for Dedicated G7-M instance family in the new Midwest region with a flexible reservation option. This ticket covers GTM sequencing, release notes coordination, console UI annotations, billing SKU mapping, partner enablement materials, and an ops runbook for first-30-days support.

milestones:
M1: Finalize SKU and pricing mapping (internal billing table) - 2026-03-12
M2: Docs & release notes draft complete - 2026-03-19
M3: Console feature flag and dashboards staged - 2026-03-22
M4: Partner enablement kit & PS-runbook reviewed - 2026-03-25
M5: Soft launch for early customers (canary) - 2026-03-29
M6: General availability and announce - 2026-04-02

release_notes:
Feature summary: G7-M instance family available in us-midwest with reservation and flexible on-demand mixing.
Breaking changes: None. Customers using region-agnostic reservation tooling should map to new SKU names as documented.
Migration notes: Customers can convert free-tier bursts to reservation credits via billing console; include step-by-step screenshots.
Console callouts: New "Midwest (us-midwest) - G7-M" entry on Dedicated region selector and reservation purchase flow.
Telemetry: New per-region latency histogram and cost-per-token panel added to Console > Dedicated > Usage.

rollout_plan:
Phase 1: Internal verification and billing SKU publish. Phase 2: Invite-only canary with three enterprise customers for perf and billing validation. Phase 3: Open self-serve reservations and enable partner SKUs. Communication to customers via release notes, status page, and targeted account outreach. Use feature flag gating in console to allow fast rollback.

dependencies:
ENG-82412: billing-sku-mapper-update
ENG-83921: console-region-selector-enhancement
ENG-84700: telemetry-add-region-panels
PM-97211: partner-sku-contracts-finalization

metrics:
Launch health: successful reservation purchases in first 72h >= 5 for canary accounts
Operational: average p50/p95 latency for G7-M within SLO (p95 < 150ms) during canary
Revenue: reservation conversion rate from invites within 14 days >= 20%
Support: number of P1/P2 issues reported in first 7 days <= 2

risks:
Billing mapping error could charge incorrect SKU leading to refunds and trust issues
Regional capacity saturation if autoscaling config misapplied; need burst fallback to central region
Console UX mismatch causing customer confusion during reservation purchase
Partner enablement materials delayed and partners unable to sell before GA

mitigations:
Run end-to-end billing test with synthetic purchase flow and accounting team sign-off
Preconfigure fallback routing to us-central with throttled quota and clear customer messaging
Staged UX review with design and a short usability test with two existing customers
Create a condensed partner one-pager and recorded demo to ship before full kit

communication_timeline:
T-14 days: Internal all-hands and docs link share
T-7 days: Partner email with enablement link and demo invite
T-3 days: Status page scheduled maintenance entry and release notes published to docs
GA day: Blog post, email to customers with eligibility and migration guidance, release notes syndicated to changelog

post_launch_tasks:
24-72h: War room monitoring and daily triage standups
Week 1: Billing reconciliation and refunds audit if needed
Week 2: Collect customer feedback and schedule follow-up UX fixes
Month 1: Review reservation uptake and propose SKU price adjustments if utilization < target
